# Alan Parra — Full Profile

## About

Alan Parra is a Software Architect and Full-Stack Developer specializing in backend systems built with .NET/C# and PHP. He designs robust, scalable and high-availability software, focusing on clean architecture, database optimization and Agile delivery.

- **Name:** Alan Parra (Alan Gilberto Parra Robledo)
- **Role:** Software Architect & Full-Stack Developer
- **Location:** Remote (Mexico, CST timezone) — open to opportunities across Europe and North America
- **Experience:** 9+ years
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (B2)
